blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Willoughby Heights
Cascadia (StreetSide Developments, Qualico) — 6951 204 Street. Strata

Listings and a building directory describe 2- and 3-bedroom, 3-storey townhomes built in 2024: 233 homes, wood frame, freehold strata (strata plan EPS9777). A current listing says pets and rentals are allowed with restrictions; confirm on the Form B.
Luxia at Yorkson — 7947 209 Street. Strata

138 three-bedroom townhouses by Isle of Mann Property Group and Pollyco Group, on a 5.44-acre site; listings record Sub-Type Townhouse / Row-Townhouse, Title to Land Freehold Strata, built 2021–2022 by unit, with a clubhouse and exercise centre among amenities. Strata plan EPS5794 is recorded in a strata-buildings index. Published rental/pet restrictions: confirm on the Form B.
Yorkson Creek (Quadra Homes) — 20738 84 Avenue. Strata

Listings record Sub-Type Townhouse / Row-Townhouse, Title to Land Freehold Strata, built 2012, with clubhouse and exercise centre amenities; one full-report listing records 171 total units in the strata while another building summary records 152 units. One listing records pets allowed with restrictions.
Gabriola Park (Royale Properties) — 20498 82 Avenue. Strata

Listings record Sub-Type Townhouse / Row-Townhouse, Title to Land Freehold Strata, built 2016–2019 by phase/unit (listings checked show 2016, 2017 and 2019 — a single project year would be wrong), described as an award-winning, pet-friendly strata with a clubhouse. Listings record pets allowed and rentals allowed for single units (listing data — confirm on the Form B).
Kensington Lofts (Vesta Properties) — 8371 202B Street. Strata

Listings record Sub-Type Townhouse, Ownership Type Freehold Strata, built 2019–2020 by unit (listings checked show both years), 3-storey townhomes with rooftop patios a recurring feature. Published rental/pet restrictions: confirm on the Form B.
Willow Park Estates (also written Willowpark Estates) — 6467 197 Street. Strata, 55+

A current listing (October 2026) calls it a "pet-friendly 55+ community" close to shopping and transit, allowing up to two cats or dogs with restrictions. The building record lists age restrictions, pets with restrictions and no rentals, though rental bans have been void since November 24, 2022.
Bakerview Estates — 20582 67 Avenue. Strata

A current listing records Building Type Townhouse, Ownership Type Freehold Strata, built 2004, 10 units in the development, with listing text stating 3 pets allowed with no height restrictions (listing data — confirm on the Form B).
Westbrooke freehold row homes (Foxridge Homes BC, Qualico) — Willoughby (Westbrooke community, beside Willoughby Town Centre). Fee-simple

The builder's own completion report states Foxridge completed the first section of its freehold row housing project as part of phase one of Qualico Communities' Westbrooke development in Langley: 21 buildings with 56 units (duplexes, triplexes and quadplexes), construction begun June 2020 with the final resident moved in at the end of January in the report year, and states the tenure expressly — freehold row homes have "the same ownership structure as a single-family home.
Streets, schools and transit near Willoughby Heights townhomes

items.t: The name Willoughby was suggested for the post office at the corner of 208 Street and 83 Avenue after the settler Willoughby, per the Township schools history document held by SD35.

The townhomes are in three main clusters: around 208 Street and 82–84 Avenue in Yorkson (Yorkson Creek, Gabriola Park, Luxia at Yorkson); along the Latimer / 200–204 Street corridor (Cascadia, Kensington Lofts); and the older complexes at the southwest edge on 197 Street and 64–67 Avenue (Willow Park Estates, Bakerview Estates).

The report combines condos and townhomes in one "attached" category and publishes no Willoughby Heights–specific median; Langley-wide (Township and City combined) attached figures for September 2026 are: median sale price $611,000; $513 per sq ft; sale-to-list 97%; 25 days on market.

Transit and roads: Highway 1 runs along the north boundary with the 200 Street, 208 Street and 216 Street interchanges; route 501 runs Surrey Central Station to Langley Centre via Fraser Highway and 200 Street, route 372 runs Clayton Heights to Langley Centre via 72 Avenue, and route 595 runs Langley Centre to Maple Ridge via the Golden Ears Bridge; service hubs are the Langley Events Centre / Carvolth Exchange area at 200 Street and Highway 1.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Willoughby Heights

items.t: Fee-simple townhomes (Westbrooke, Brighton West, non-strata row houses): The Westbrooke builder source makes the same point: full ownership of building and land, no strata corporation unless owners later create one for a joint project.

Zoning: Township Zoning Bylaw No. 2500 applies. Willoughby's compact-lot zone, R-CL, allows lots from 220 m² to 464.5 m², with at least 11 m of frontage for front-loaded lots and 8.2 m for lane-access lots. A coach house is a fee-simple second unit, never strata.

blocks.text: Good to know about Willoughby Heights townhomes

items.t: Cascadia is still under its new-home warranty: listings note 2-5-10 coverage, with the building envelope covered to 2029 and structure to 2034 for the 2024 build. Ask about the warranty transfer and any claims so far.

Trinity Western University's Smith campus is inside the area at 8086 - 208 Street, and the university's campus expansion in southeast Willoughby is named in the Township's phase-1 background paper — part of the rental-demand story Yorkson landlords cite.

Yorkson Creek runs through the east side, and Township Willoughby materials flag hazards around greenways and creeks in the plan area — check creek and greenway setbacks on east-side lots before pricing a renovation or addition.

Care and hospital anchors are on the wider Langley corridors, not in the townhouse nodes: Langley Memorial Hospital, 22051 Fraser Highway (Fraser Health), and the Langley Urgent and Primary Care Centre at 202 - 20434 64 Avenue, at its permanent location per Fraser Health. Muriel Arnason Library, 130 - 20338 65 Avenue, is the Fraser Valley Regional Library branch in Willoughby.

faq.q: What should I check on a townhome in Willoughby?
faq.a: Read the Form B, the bylaws, the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and ask about exterior repairs, pet and rental rules and who looks after the fences, roofs and yards.

faq.q: Are townhomes in Willoughby freehold or strata?
faq.a: Most are strata, either a building strata or a bare-land strata, with monthly fees and bylaws. Some are freehold row homes with no strata. The title search tells you which, and it decides which costs and rules apply.
